utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m rallying folks for the Saturday morning repair drive—if you know anyone handy or willing to pitch in, send them my way and I’ll get them plugged in.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Quinn — I’m in for Saturday morning, and I can pitch in a bit, but I’m still waiting on Mara’s final list before I grab tools. If anyone has a hammer, screws, tape, or gloves, that’d help too.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: That’s great, Dane — I’ll mark you down for Saturday morning and keep asking around for a hammer, screws, tape, and gloves while we wait on Mara’s final list.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Morning, Nell — I’ve got the repair drive down for Saturday at 10, starting with the fence panel and then the porch light. If you hear where Opal wants the bins or whether we need tables, let me know so I can keep the plan tidy.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Morning, Eli — I’ve only heard second-hand, but I’ll check with Rosa or Opal about the bins and tables and pass it along. I’m already helping sort tool requests at 10, so I’ll keep an eye on keeping things tidy.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Thanks, Nell — that’s just what I needed. I’ll stick with Saturday at 10 and wait for your word on the bins and tables before I tell the others anything definite.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Saturday at 10 works for me, but I’m still checking the school calendar before I confirm it with the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So it’s not confirmed yet, right? Just let me know once the school calendar is set and we can count on Saturday at 10.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Right, it’s not confirmed yet — I’ll check the school calendar today and let you know as soon as Saturday at 10 is solid.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Hey Cleo, I think we’re still aiming for Saturday morning for the repair drive, but I may have missed an update—did Mara confirm what folks should bring?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I haven’t heard a full confirmation from Mara yet, but I’m still checking what we’ve got on hand. If you hear any update, let me know.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Will do—I'll keep it as Saturday morning for now, but won’t tell folks a bring-list until Mara confirms. Thanks for checking what we’ve got, Cleo.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Hi Vik — I’m trying to pin down the repair drive logistics so we’re not scrambling. Do you know the firm end time or any supplies we’re still short on?

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I don’t have a firm end time yet, Pia — I’ll keep checking and reminding folks, and so far Rey’s planning to bring duct tape and work gloves for Saturday morning.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Vik — that helps, though I’d still really like a cutoff time before Saturday. Could you let me know as soon as you hear, and I’ll keep the supply list updated around Rey’s tape and gloves?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Hana, I’ve been telling folks Saturday morning by the community shed, but you’re the one with the real word—do we have a confirmed time and supply list yet?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Not confirmed yet, Tess — I’m still waiting on Mara for the exact time and supply list, so please tell folks it’s tentative until I can verify it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Got it, Hana — I’ll make sure folks know Saturday morning by the shed is only tentative until you hear back from Mara.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Oren, can you confirm whether we’re set for Saturday at 10 a.m., and do you have screws, hinges, or gloves you can bring?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yes, I’m pretty sure we’re set for Saturday at 10 by the community shed. I can bring gloves and a little box of screws, though I’ll have to check if I’ve got any hinges tucked away.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Good, bring the gloves and screws for sure, and let me know by tomorrow if you find hinges. Can you also check whether the shed will be unlocked before 10?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Mara, quick check: is the repair drive Saturday at 10, and what’s actually on the fix list? I’ve got folks asking and I don’t want to garble it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Saturday morning at the community shed is what I’m hearing, Bo, but I’m still confirming whether 10 is firm. The fix list is still being gathered too, so tell folks I’ll send the confirmed time and repair list as soon as I have them.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it, I’ll tell them Saturday morning at the shed for now, with time and fix list still pending from you.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Hi Jules — my latest note says the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center, though I’m still confirming the exact time and helper list.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Thanks, Opal — I’ll hold off on telling folks Saturday at 10 and let Bo and Faye know we’re waiting on the Sunday time and helper list before I match up tools.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Perfect, thank you, Jules — I’ll mark Saturday at 10 as unconfirmed and keep Sunday at the community center as the current plan until Rosa sends the final time and helper list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Rosa, the repair drive is Saturday at 10 a.m.; right now we most need extension cords, labels, and someone to check people in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Leo — small correction: the repair drive has moved to Sunday at the community center. Extension cords, labels, and check-in help are still exactly what we need, so I’ll update the helper list now.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Got it — Sunday at the community center. I’ll tell Sam and Faye, and I can still bring screwdrivers and tape.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I can help a little with the repair drive, Rey, but I’ll need to keep it brief. Sunday at the community center works for sorting a few supplies.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Uli — sorting a few supplies on Sunday would help. I’m bringing duct tape and work gloves too, once I get the exact drop-off window.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rey. Just let me know the window when you have it, and I’ll come by for a short bit to sort what I can.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Gus, last I heard the repair drive still needed screwdrivers, packing tape, and folks to carry boxes or sort donations — and Leo said he can bring some supplies and help for an hour.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Great, thanks Ira — I’ve already got screwdrivers and duct tape set aside, and I can pitch in carrying boxes or sorting donations once the time’s confirmed.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s perfect, Gus — I’ll pass along that you’ve got screwdrivers and tape, plus help once the time’s set.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Hey Vik, I’m ready to bring the drill, screwdrivers, duct tape, and I’ll see if I’ve got spare screws or hinges too—just let me know once the time is set.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Gus — we’re set for Saturday morning at 10 for the repair drive, so bring those along and I’ll keep reminding everyone else too.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Perfect, Saturday at 10 works for me — I’ll bring the drill, screwdrivers, duct tape, and any spare screws or hinges I can find.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Hi Hana — I’ve got duct tape and a couple pairs of work gloves set aside, and I’ll drop them off before the repair drive starts once I know the time window.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Thanks, Rey — please hold onto them for now, because I’m still waiting on Mara to confirm the repair drive date, time window, and exact supply list.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Got it, I’ll keep them set aside and wait for the confirmed date, time window, and supply list before dropping anything off.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Saturday at 10 still works. We most need labeled boxes, extension cords, and folks to check in items as they arrive.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Great, thanks Leo — I’ll mark Saturday at 10 as confirmed and put labeled boxes, extension cords, and check-in volunteers at the top of the list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Perfect, thanks Mara. That should cover the biggest gaps.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hi Dane — I’m helping with the repair drive Saturday at 10 by the community shed, and I can track what still needs fixing. Do you know how long we expect it to run?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, I’m just catching up too — I’ve heard Saturday morning, but I don’t know the end time yet. I’m waiting on Mara’s final list before I commit tools or details.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks, Dane — I’ll plan on Saturday at 10 and keep the fix-it list flexible until Mara’s final list comes through.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Kira, the repair drive is set for Saturday at 10, and Mara’s still gathering the repair list — if you know anyone with tools to lend or repairs to request, send them my way and I’ll match things up.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So Saturday at 10 is confirmed, and Mara’s the one collecting the repair list? I can ask around, but I want to be sure you’re still mainly short on screwdrivers, packing tape, and extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Yes, Saturday at 10 is confirmed, and Mara’s collecting the repair list. I know we’ll need extra hands, but I don’t want to overstate the specific tools until Mara’s list is in—screwdrivers are likely helpful, and I’ll confirm the rest as soon as I have it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Hey Opal, I only skimmed the note, but yeah, community shed sounds right—can you send me the time and quick repair list when you’ve got it?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Thanks, Bo — I’ve got your note, but Rosa said Sunday at the community center, so I’m going to double-check before I send you the time and repair list.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good—just send me the confirmed time and the quick repair list when you have it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh Nell, what I’ve heard is Saturday morning at the community shed, with folks hoping for plenty of volunteers and supplies. I’m still keeping an ear out in case Rosa or Hana confirm anything different.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That matches what I’ve heard, Tess—Jules asked me to come by around 10 to sort Mara’s tool requests, so I’ll pass along anything new if I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Perfect, Nell — 10 sounds like a sensible time to aim for, and I’ll let folks know to check in around the shed unless Rosa or Hana say otherwise.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great—what time will you be there, and can you bring any spare screws or hinges?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: I’m not sure I’ll make it over myself, Mina—I’m mostly running errands and passing along updates, but I’ll check at home for spare screws or hinges and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, Ira—please let me know by Friday if you find any screws or hinges, and can you also pass along that we’re aiming for Saturday at 10 a.m.?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Oren, I’m rallying folks for the repair drive Saturday morning—can you help spread the word or send over anyone handy? We’re especially short on screwdrivers, packing tape, and people who can carry boxes.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Absolutely, Quinn — I’ll tell folks Saturday at 10 and ask around for screwdrivers, packing tape, and box-carriers. If I start saying the wrong thing, give me a nudge, will you?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll keep you on track, and I really appreciate you spreading the word. Send anyone you find my way and I’ll plug them in.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Wonderful, thank you, Uli — Sunday at the community center is perfect. I’ll put you down for a brief supply-sorting shift and keep it simple when you arrive.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thank you, Rosa. I’ll come by Sunday and sort what I can for a short while.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: That’s perfect, Uli — I really appreciate it. I’ll have the supplies labeled so you can jump in quickly and head out when you need to.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hi Eli, I’ve got the repair drive penciled in for Saturday at 10 a.m., but I’m still checking the school calendar before I tell the other parents.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: That works for me, Faye — Saturday at 10 is still the plan on my end. Let me know once the school calendar is confirmed, and I’ll keep it simple from there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Eli — I’ll confirm the school calendar today and then let the other parents know Saturday at 10 is the plan.
